scheme_name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme: Facilitation Supports
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to any group of artisans
Applicant must be engaged in traditional craft or trade using hand tools, equipment or small machines
Applicant must be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers
Applicant must be an Indian citizen and a permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years
benefits_summary: Provides facilitation support for artisans' enrollment on the State Portal, formation of Industrial Cooperative Societies, and obtaining statutory requirements.
